summary: An inline single-date Calendar and a RangeCalendar, each printing its selected value below.
use: Always-visible date selection such as booking a stay or choosing an event day without a popover.
spec: `let range = $state<DateRange>({ start: undefined, end: undefined })` starts empty
Output lines show `fmt(value)`, `fmt(range.start)` and `fmt(range.end)`, with `–` when unset
